changes: No content changes. Added notes on the granthasaṃkhyā figure and the CE conversion.

notes: The owner's name in the ownership formula ('idaṃ pustaka ⟪‥‥‥‥⟫sya ... na tvanyasyaiva') has been rubbed out or can't be read, so no owner is recorded. The colophon gives no scribe. The era is not named and is taken as VS, in line with the catalogue field. In VS 1830 Caitra śukla falls in March–April 1773 CE. 'granthasaṃkhyā 26' appears twice and is marked (!) by the cataloguer. It is probably a shortened or corrupt figure, since a 107-folio text would be far longer than 26 ślokas.
